9613.d: Enakhra's Temple is an underground complex located south of the Bandit Camp in the Kharidian Desert.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
There are several ways to get to the temple. The temple is in the hot desert, so take precautions against the effects of desert heat.
• Teleport to the Bandit Camp lodestone and walk south-west (Desert Treasure required).
• Go to Shantay Pass and walk south-west from there. The temple is a long walk from the pass, however.
• A network of magic carpets goes to various locations in the desert. The closest ones to the temple are the Bedabin Camp (walk south from there), Monkey colony (walk north and south, requires Do No Evil), Menaphos (walk north), although none of them is particularly close to the temple. Each carpet flight costs as much as 200 coins, although prices are reduced depending upon whether you have complete enough of the Rogue Trader minigame and/or are wearing a ring of charos.
• The Pharaoh's sceptre can teleport to Jaldraocht Pyramid, which is near the temple. Walk west from the pyramid. The sceptre can be purchased on the Grand Exchange or can be found playing the Pyramid Plunder minigame. The sceptre has three charges, which can be replenished by the Guardian mummy of Pyramid Plunder.
• The camulet teleports to the northeast entrances of the temple itself and thus is by far the quickest way to get there. The camulet is an award of the Enakhra's Lament quest. The camulet has four charges, which can be replenished by using a bucket of camel dung on the amulet. If you lose your camulet, you can get another one from Lazim, who is in the temple.
